source_intake.temporal_skew_assessment: No catastrophic calendar interval hole; category/query capping was the material completeness risk.

annual_phase_candidates.interpretation: Frontier chat/multimodal capability and open-model replication both become visible as parallel directions.
Adaptation, evaluation, tool interfaces and serving infrastructure become distinct technical layers around the model.
Open-weight specialization, long-context competition, generative-media integration and deployment diversity accelerate.
Multimodal/platform productization, MoE and alternative architectures, faster media generation, and explicit control/governance surfaces make the system/ecosystem view dominant.

annual_trajectories: frontier interaction: long context and multimodality become user-facing platform properties
open-weight ecosystem: model families diversify by scale, language, specialization and architecture
tool/action layer: model output becomes structured input to external execution
runtime/adaptation layer: fine-tuning memory, kernels, cache management and serving become first-class constraints
reasoning/retrieval/architecture: inference-time search, preference optimization, retrieval-control and alternative sequence models expand the design space
generative media: image/video generation branches into open models, APIs and creative-tool integration
evaluation/control: shared evaluation infrastructure and capability-risk governance emerge alongside stronger systems
editorial_thesis: 2023年、生成AIは単一の巨大言語モデルやチャットボットを競う段階から、長文脈・マルチモーダルなフロンティア、公開weightsの多様なモデル群、外部ツールと接続するaction layer、低コスト化する学習・推論runtime、独立した生成メディア、そして評価・安全制御を含む多層のシステム／生態系へ拡張した。

architecture.approximate_reader_facing_chronology_eve: 60-75 provisional material events; exact count is deferred to chronology assembly after Architecture approval

residual_claim_boundaries: Vendor, project and author performance/capability evaluations remain attributed rather than treated as independently reproduced results.
Nominal context-window size is not treated as evidence of uniformly effective long-context use.
Preview, paper publication, model release, API availability, device deployment and product integration remain distinct chronology states.
Current publisher indexes and capped arXiv slices cannot establish historical absence.
One planned llama.cpp commit-level historical locator was unavailable and remains a runtime-history limitation.

single_volume_coherence.assessment: The seven trajectories interact strongly enough to support a year-scale thesis. No evidence-backed need to split 2023 into H1/H2 was found.
